# Candor

> Flat-fee B Corp and sustainability certification consulting for small businesses in British Columbia, Canada.

For a full list of our services and compliance summaries, please see our [Full Text Corpus](https://candorcertified.com/llms-full.txt).

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://candorcertified.com/): An overview of Candor's consulting model run by Artem Furman.
- [Contact & Booking](https://calendly.com/artemfurman/30min): Link to book a direct 30-minute consultation call.
- [Free Readiness Score](https://candorcertified.com/assessment/): Four-question, two-minute check showing which of B Lab's seven required impact topics a business already covers, the two gaps to close first and a realistic timeline. No email needed.
- [Resources / Blog](https://candorcertified.com/blog/): Articles on B Corp certification, B Lab's 2026 standards, and verification.

## Legal
- [Privacy Policy](https://candorcertified.com/privacy-policy/): PIPEDA / BC PIPA privacy policy, cookie and analytics disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://candorcertified.com/terms/): Engagement terms, fees, cancellation and refund policy.
